messages:
ellen-m: quick note 1: our suppression flow doesn't tie to KMS audit entries. if a finding is suppressed, we still need a clear KMS unwrap audit for future repro.

bia-g: agreed. current scanner uses a broad service account to fetch artifacts. can we narrow it so unwraps require scan_id & justification header?

infra-bot: proposal: scanner_role_v2 with condition: request.headers.scan_id != null && resource.labels.scan=true. logs to security-central.

devsec-bot: nightly-scan-900 produced 4 criticals; 1 is suppressed (id=S-900a). https://ci/reports/900

ellen-m: add to playbook: suppressed findings must record: suppressor, reason, expiry, artifact_wrap_id, kms_log_entry_id. searchable via auditsvc.

auditsvc: note: we can surface kms_log_entry_id as a trace_id. retention default 365d for high severity actions.

bia-g: auto-reopen rules? recommend reopen if suppressed && (prod_error_rate_spike OR external_exploit_score>=7). also require KMS unwrap event within last 30d to consider evidence valid.

devsec-bot: DAST note: runtime repro logs (request headers, response bodies mask PII) should be stored compressed for 30d when attached to triage ticket.

ellen-m: suppression metadata schema example (for triage consumer): {finding_id, repo, commit, suppressor, reason, expires_at, artifact_wrap_id, kms_log_id, provenance}. keep small.

bia-g: infra will land IAM PR for scanner_role_v2 and a tiny KMS policy draft. tagging @ellen-m for review.

infra-bot: PR created: https://gh/pulls/infra/scan-role-v2. reviewers: @bia-g @ellen-m.

ellen-m: thanks. i'll update the RFC with retention tiers and reopen logic, then run a 2-service canary.

bia-g: great. adding a test case to the scanner harness: suppress -> produce prod spike -> expect reopen. :white_check_mark:

ellen-m: closing loop, will post the RFC link here when ready.
